_source: Assignment 1 Data Pack — all 4 source types. Commitments extracted by reading every source message and identifying: (a) who made a promise, (b) to whom, (c) what the deliverable is, (d) the deadline, and (e) whether it was resolved. No ownership was invented where the source is ambiguous.
_extraction_approach: Rule-based, deterministic extraction from the 71 normalised SourceMessages. Each commitment includes a full evidence chain (source_ids + verbatim evidence texts) so any claim can be traced back to its exact source. Where a deadline evolved across messages, all versions are preserved under deadline_history and the latest supported deadline is used.
_note_on_demo_date: Wednesday 23 Sep is the most revealing snapshot: the vendor list is overdue, the Mumbai lease is unowned, the Meridian call is imminent, and board prep is the next day. The agent's 'today' should be anchored to this date for demo purposes.
